name: klay14
caption:
14 THREES IN 27 MINUTES? 🎮🏀 Klay Thompson hit 14 threes. He played 27 minutes.

• Before that night: 5 for 36 from three in his first 7 games
• Oct 29, 2018 at Chicago: 14 of 24 from three, breaking Steph's record of 13
• 52 points
• We win 149-124

Will anyone ever hit 15? 👇

beats.head: 14 THREES IN 27 MIN?
beats.name: KLAY
beats.vo: Klay Thompson hit fourteen threes. He only played twenty-seven minutes.

beats.head: 5 FOR 36
beats.name: KLAY
beats.vo: And he'd started that season ice cold. Five for thirty-six from three in his first seven games.
beats.dlg: HIS FIRST 7 GAMES:|5 FOR 36 FROM THREE.

beats.head: THE RECORD
beats.name: KLAY
beats.vo: October twenty-ninth, twenty eighteen, in Chicago. He breaks Steph's record of thirteen.

beats.head: 52 POINTS
beats.name: KLAY
beats.vo: Fourteen of twenty-four from three. Fifty-two points.

beats.head: BLOWOUT
beats.name: KLAY
beats.vo: We win, one forty-nine to one twenty-four.

beats.head: 15 EVER?
beats.vo: Fourteen threes in one night. Will anyone ever hit fifteen? Comment below.

facts.claim: Over the first seven (7) games of the 2018-19 season, Thompson shot 5 for 36 from behind the arc; on October 29, 2018, against the Chicago Bulls, he hit an NBA-record 14 threes to break Curry's former mark of 13, scoring 52 points in 27 minutes; nobody has hit 15
